description.value: Bombay Kitchen and Bar is an Indian restaurant on Vancouver's beloved Commercial Drive, self-described as the highest-rated Indian restaurant in Vancouver. The menu ranges from traditional regional curries and mughal-inspired rice dishes to tandoori specialties baked in a Jaipuri clay oven, with a dedicated street food section featuring pani puri and chaat. Dine-in service is complemented by direct online ordering with delivery from the restaurant.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 26m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and confirms an active Indian restaurant on Commercial Drive with dine-in and online ordering/delivery, and explicitly mentions 'many Vegetarian and Vegan options' confirmed by the menu (Veggie Pakora, Tofu Tikka, Paneer dishes, etc.). OSM tags supply address and phone, but the website contact page shows only an email address and no phone number, so phone cannot be confirmed; the website references 'The Drive - Commercial Drive' but gives no street number to cross-check the address. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-touring infrastructure appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Phone number (+1-604-336-1111) from OSM could not be confirmed via website; the contact page shows only an email address (info@bombaykitchenandbar.ca).
Street address (1018 Commercial Drive) could not be confirmed from website content, which references only 'The Drive - Commercial Drive' without a street number.
No cycle-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) could be confirmed from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active sit-down restaurant on Commercial Drive — a high-cycling-traffic corridor — with strong vegetarian and vegan menu options that would appeal to touring cyclists seeking a substantial meal stop.
